get_builtin_metadata_for_dataset: get built-in metadata dict for a dataset like coco, cityscapes, or coco_person by name
get_coco_instances_meta: get COCO instance metadata with 80 thing classes, colors, and id mappings
get_coco_panoptic_separated_meta: get COCO panoptic separated metadata with 53 stuff classes and thing mappings
get_imagenet_instances_meta: get ImageNet instance metadata with single foreground class and image count
get_UVO_instances_meta: get UVO instance metadata with single object class and image count
